name: International Dues Paid to TI
budget_rationale: TI raised semiannual dues from $60 to $72 ($120/yr to $144/yr) effective August 3, 2026; members who renew before that date keep the $120/yr rate. Assumes 25 of the club’s 130 total members (110 existing + 20 new) renew early at the old rate and the remaining 105 renew at the new rate, plus the $25 one-time registration fee for each of the 20 new members. Calculated as (25 x $120) + (105 x $144) + (20 x $25) = $3,000 + $15,120 + $500 = $18,620.
